en.headline: Tourism Board to stage first international lantern show at Victoria Park
en.dek: The International Lantern Spectacular will run from 17 to 27 September beside the LCSD carnival, with displays lit from 6.30 p.m. and free admission.
body: The Hong Kong Tourism Board said on Thursday it will hold its first International Lantern Spectacular at Victoria Park from 17 to 27 September, themed Reunion, alongside the Leisure and Cultural Services Department’s annual Mid-Autumn Lantern Carnival.

According to the Board, a World Lantern Boulevard will present more than 3,000 lanterns from 20 countries and regions, including silk lanterns from Jinju in South Korea, patchwork lanterns from Brazil and Polish pieces using traditional paper-cutting. A Nanjing team has been invited to build four large Qinhuai lanterns using a craft listed as national intangible cultural heritage, including an eight-metre entrance work inspired by Hong Kong banyan trees.

A separate pavilion will show more than 400 locally made lanterns in shapes such as rabbits, star fruit and goldfish. The Tourism Board’s executive director, Dane Cheng, said the new event would sit with the LCSD carnival and other Mid-Autumn activities, including the Tai Hang Fire Dragon Dance from 24 to 26 September.

The Leisure and Cultural Services Department said its carnival at the same park is free, with lanterns lit from 6.30 p.m. to 11 p.m. daily and until midnight on 25 September, Mid-Autumn Festival. The Tourism Board gave the same lighting hours for its displays. Admission is free.

zh.headline: 旅發局首辦國際中秋綵燈匯 9月17日起維園免費開放
zh.dek: 活動與康文署中秋綵燈會同期舉行，展出來自20個國家及地區的綵燈，每晚6時半亮燈。
body: 香港旅遊發展局周四公布，將於9月17日至27日首次在維多利亞公園舉辦「國際中秋綵燈匯」，主題為「團圓」，並與康樂及文化事務署每年在維園舉行的中秋綵燈會同期進行。
旅發局表示，「世界綵燈大街」將展出逾3,000盞來自20個國家及地區的特色燈籠，包括韓國晉州絲綢燈籠、巴西拼布燈籠及採用民間剪紙工藝的波蘭綵燈。局方亦邀請南京製作團隊以國家級非物質文化遺產秦淮燈藝打造四組巨型燈組，包括正門一座以本港大榕樹為靈感、高約8米的作品。
另設展區擺放逾400盞本地手紮花燈，造型包括玉兔、楊桃及金魚。旅發局總幹事劉鎮漢表示，新活動將與康文署綵燈會及大坑舞火龍等節慶一併推廣，舞火龍訂於9月24至26日舉行。
康文署指維園綵燈會免費入場，亮燈時間為每日下午6時30分至晚上11時，中秋當日9月25日延長至午夜。旅發局公布的亮燈時間相同。
